content_data.meeting_title: Regional Healthcare Security Pilot - Phase 1 Review & Next Steps
agenda_items: Analysis of initial security incident metrics and mitigation strategies
Identification of key risks and dependencies for the next period
Assessment of compliance readiness for upcoming regulatory changes
key_decisions: Greenlit procurement of advanced threat detection software for evaluation in Phase 2.
